passport.model: F3_g (streamable CNN: close, HL/2, HLC/3 steps + bar range; side inputs v7tcp)
passport.training: prod: all data of 31 assets (FIT + TUNE + VALIDATION), 15 epochs, cosine lr

inputs.bar_time: open time of the bar, UTC milliseconds
inputs.norm: median(high - low) over the 200 bars before the bar (closed left); even count: mean of the two middle
inputs.valid_bar: norm finite and > 0, no grid gap (interval > 450000 ms), previous bar exists, previous bar has a norm (for d of HL/2, HLC/3)
inputs.step_p: (p - close[1]) / norm - (p[1] - close[1]) / norm[1], p = HL/2 and HLC/3
inputs.divisor_D: max(median |r| over the window (even: mean of two middle), floor of the symbol)
inputs.pooling: layer 4 outputs at the last 33 bars of the chosen stream: mean, max, last; each / D
inputs.ema: normalized EMA (pandas adjust=True, NaN skipped) of |r| over valid bars, spans 2016 and 288
side: vol_to_7d = log(D) - log(EMA|r| span 2016 at the last bar)
hour_sin, hour_cos = sin/cos(2 pi * (minutes of day / 60) / 24) of the last bar
dow_sin, dow_cos = sin/cos(2 pi * dow / 7), dow = (floor(time / 86400000) + 3) % 7, Monday = 0
move_1d / 3d / 7d: sum of r over the 288 / 864 / 2016 bars before the bar preceding the window, / (sqrt(n) * EMA|r| span 288 at the bar preceding the window) * sgn
path_*: same over 8 blocks of 16 bars (last 128 bars before the bar preceding the window), oldest first
inputs.head: logit = head3_w . relu(head0_w @ [pooled(96), side_std(16)] + head0_b) + head3_b

tie_rule.x_end: sum_{i=0..63} i * r_i / 64 over the window (end of the centered close path)
tie_rule.rule: sgn = -1 if x_end < -eps * D else +1; one sign for the stream and the side inputs

floors.unknown_rule: median of floor_L64 of the 31 table symbols
floors.source: smc_series files of the prod training: fresh data folder for BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, research data folder for the rest

calibration.fit_on: VAL refit a+b, 31 assets, both halves
calibration.unknown_symbol: same Platt (global), note in the corner

display.line: M = exp(|platt_a * logit + platt_b|); more frequent than random if platt_a * logit + platt_b > 0, less frequent if < 0; floor 1.0
display.threshold: visual only: input >= 1, default 3 (bright above, pale below, dashed line, optional marks)
display.ceiling_rule: docs/rules.md R9 (pool, at most 21) and R11 (per symbol: the lower edge of the first bin of the symbol where factual / expected < 0.8 or < 1000 windows of a class; unknown symbol: the lowest of FIL, LINK, XLM); above the ceiling the line stays at it, "N+"
display.unknown_symbol: not Binance spot from the table (prefix BINANCE, no .P): floor unknown_symbol + note
display.timeframe: 5M only checked; other timeframes: drawn with a note
